svg.title: Long context has three separate failure modes
svg.desc: Long-context challenges include unseen positions, quadratic attention memory/compute, and uneven use such as lost in the middle. Position Interpolation rescales positions, ALiBi adds a distance penalty, and ring attention lowers per-device memory without reducing total quadratic FLOPs.

g.text: Long context has three separate failure modes
Position, memory/compute, and uneven use need different fixes.
WHAT BREAKS → WHAT HELPS → WHAT IT DOES NOT FIX
ALiBi changes attention scores; Position Interpolation rescales positions; neither makes all long-context evidence equally usable.
